} else {
return Self.params.url + "&zone_id=" + zone_ids.join(',') + '&hb=' + guid;
}
};
Self.filterIDs = function(zone_list, filters){
//filter zone IDs
var zone_ids = [],
zones = (typeof filters[Self.params.page_name] == "undefined") ? filters['default'] : filters[Self.params.page_name], 
zones_length = zones.length,
i = 0;
for (;i<zones_length; i++) {
zone_ids.push(Self.params.zones_list[zones[i]]);
}	
if ((Self.params.preroll_zone_id != null)
&& (typeof Self.params.preroll_zone_id[Self.params.platform] != 'undefined')
&& (Self.params.preroll_zone_id[Self.params.platform] != null)) {
zone_ids.push(Self.params.preroll_zone_id[Self.params.platform]);
}
return zone_ids;
};
Self.makeRequest = function(requestType) {
if (Self.zone_ids.length == 0) return;
if (requestType == 'script') {
var el = document.createElement('script'),
s = document.getElementsByTagName('script')[0];
el.type = 'text/javascript'; 
el.async = true;
el.src = Self.url,
s.parentNode.insertBefore(el, s);
return;
}	
if (requestType == 'pixel') {
var img = document.createElement("img"),
elBody = document.getElementsByTagName("BODY")[0];
img.setAttribute('src', Self.url);
if (elBody !== null) {
elBody.insertBefore(img, elBody.firstChild);
}
return;
}
if ((requestType == 'xhr') && (typeof XMLHttpRequest != "undefined")) {
var a = new XMLHttpRequest();
a.open("GET", Self.url, true);
a.withCredentials = true;
a.send(null);
return;
}
};
Self.process = function(params) {
Self.params = params;
Self.zone_ids = [];
if (params.filter_zones) {
Self.filterIDs(params.zones_list, params.filter_array[Self.params.platform]) 
} else { 
for (var zone in params.zones_list) {
if (params.zones_list.hasOwnProperty(zone)) {
Self.zone_ids.push(params.zones_list[zone]);
}
}
};
Self.url = Self.prepareUrl(params.platform, Self.zone_ids, Self.params.guid);
Self.makeRequest(params.type); //'script', 'xhr' or 'pixel'
};
Self.getHB = function() {
return (Self.zone_ids.length == 0) ? "" : "&hb=" + Self.params.guid;
}
return Self.process(params);
}
page_params.isPartnerVideo = false;
var tj_hb_config = {
type : 'script', // script, xhr, pixel

filter_array : {"header":3811,"default":2545,"footer":2547},
page_name : page_params.current_action,
platform : "pc",
preroll_zone_id : null
}

tjHeaderBidding = tjHB.getHB();

function setLogo(logo) {
var now = new Date();
var startDay = new Date(logo.startDate);
var endDay = new Date(logo.endDate);
if ((now.getTime() > startDay.getTime()) && (now.getTime() < endDay.getTime())) {
document.getElementById("js_logo_img").src = logo.url;
document.getElementById("js_logo_img").alt = logo.alt;
document.getElementById("js_logo_img").title = logo.alt;
return true;
} else {
return false;
}
}
function processLogo(logos) {
for (var i = 0; i < logos.length; i += 1) {
logos[i].startDate = logos[i].startDate.replace(/-/g, '/');
logos[i].endDate = logos[i].endDate.replace(/-/g, '/');
if (setLogo(logos[i])) {
break;
}
}
}

<script>
page_params.main_search_obj = {
btnSearch: document.getElementById('search-trigger')
};
var searchContent = [];
page_params.searchContentParams = [
{
container: '.js_search_terms_row',
selector: '.js_search_terms_row .js_scrollableContent',
perPage: 2.7
},
{
container: '.js_search_pornstar_list_row',
selector: '.js_search_pornstar_list_row .js_scrollableContent',
perPage: 2.3
},
{
container: '.js_search_channel_list_row',
selector: '.js_search_channel_list_row .js_scrollableContent',
perPage: 3.6
},
{
container: '.js_search_categories_list_row',
selector: '.js_search_categories_list_row .js_scrollableContent',
perPage: 2.7
},
];
/* callback function to add/remove scroll */
page_params.main_search_obj.onOpenAutoFill = function () {
var _loop = function _loop(i) {
if (!document.querySelector(page_params.searchContentParams[i].selector)) return 'continue';
/***** reinstall plagin params once again *****/
searchContent[i] = new ScrollableContent(page_params.searchContentParams[i]);
var container = document.querySelector(page_params.searchContentParams[i].container),
prevBtn = container.querySelector('.js_arrowLeft'),
nextBtn = container.querySelector('.js_arrowRight');
if (prevBtn) {
MG_Utils.removeClass(prevBtn, 'is-hidden');
prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
return searchContent[i].prev();
});
}
if (nextBtn) {
MG_Utils.removeClass(nextBtn, 'is-hidden');
nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
return searchContent[i].next();
});
}
};
for (var i = 0; i < page_params.searchContentParams.length; i++) {
var _ret = _loop(i);
if (_ret === 'continue') continue;
}
};
page_params.main_search_obj.onClose = function () {
for (var i = 0; i < page_params.searchContentParams.length; i++){
searchContent[i].destroy(true);
}
};
</script>
